title: Opening autocomplete results in new browser tabs
body:
Like many people, I'm a heavy user of middle click or ctrl+click to open links in new browser tabs.

Very sadly, this doesn't work for Algolia autocomplete suggestions… (demo search boxes: https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/ – https://laravel.com/)

Maybe related: #323, #481

comments.body: Hi @vlakoff, can you provide us a list of steps to reproduce the behavior you are experiencing? Thanks

1. Go to one of the websites mentioned above.
2. In the search box at top of the page, type some characters. Suggestions should be displayed below the box.
3. Middle click on a suggestion: nothing happens.
4. Ctrl+click on a suggestion: opens in the same browser tab.

Expected: both middle click and ctrl+click should open links in new browser tabs.

Tested on Firefox and Chrome.
